description: The oracle: run the markdown `/pan:exec-phase 1 --skip-tests` on the same two-plan seed and assert the same outcomes as the native run.
why: Oracle diffing (stability doctrine). A native workflow is only worth shipping if its chain completes at least as often as the prose path it ports. Same seed, same assertions, different orchestration — the comparison is the finding, not either run alone. Run --repeat 5 alongside native-exec-waves-chain.

steps.why: Identical outcome assertions to the native run, minus the verification file (the markdown path hands verification to the transition step, which this seed disarms with auto_advance:false).
Working code, not files that look right.
